title: SEBI CSCRF (code-observable subset)
notes: READ THIS BEFORE USING THE RESULTS. Docket's restatement of SEBI's Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework for regulated entities, organised by the framework's own functions — Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover — which follow the NIST Cybersecurity Framework structure. Citations name the FUNCTION and theme, not a clause number, because a wrong clause reference on a regulatory report is worse than no reference; follow source_url for the authoritative circular. MOST OF CSCRF IS ORGANISATIONAL: governance, the cyber capability index, audits, SOC arrangements, VAPT cadence, incident reporting timelines, third-party governance. Those are marked `process`, are never assessed, and are never counted as satisfied. Only the minority marked `source` are answerable by reading an application repository, and this pack is not an attestation of compliance with CSCRF.

controls.title: Authorisation enforced per record and per function
controls.requirement: Access to data and functions must be restricted to authorised users on the principle of least privilege, verified server-side for the specific record and operation requested.
controls.citation: CSCRF Protect — Identity management, authentication and access control
controls.evidence_hint: handlers fetching a record by a client-supplied id with no owner or entity filter; privileged routes with no role check; authorisation present on some handlers of a module and missing on others

controls.title: Strong authentication implemented correctly
controls.requirement: Access to critical systems and investor-facing services must use multi-factor authentication, verified server-side, with the second factor bounded in lifetime and single-use.
controls.citation: CSCRF Protect — Identity management and authentication
controls.evidence_hint: an OTP or second factor generated and verified server-side; whether it expires and cannot be reused; whether a later endpoint can be called directly to bypass the step; JWTs verified with a pinned algorithm

controls.title: Authentication secrets stored irreversibly
controls.requirement: Passwords and PINs must be stored with a salted, computationally expensive key derivation function, must not be recoverable, and must not appear in logs or notifications.
controls.citation: CSCRF Protect — Identity management and access control
controls.evidence_hint: a general-purpose digest applied to a password; reversible encryption of a credential; a password or OTP written to a log or an email body

controls.title: Sessions bounded and invalidated
controls.requirement: Sessions must expire on idle and at an absolute limit, be invalidated on logout and credential change, and session cookies must carry secure, http-only and same-site attributes.
controls.citation: CSCRF Protect — Identity management and access control
controls.evidence_hint: session or token configuration with no expiry; cookie flags left at defaults; a logout that clears only the client; no session rotation after authentication

controls.title: No credentials embedded in application code
controls.requirement: Application, database and third-party credentials must be supplied at run time from a protected store and must never be committed to source control.
controls.citation: CSCRF Protect — Data security and platform security
controls.evidence_hint: literal passwords, API keys or connection strings in source or committed configuration; a committed .env or properties file carrying live values

controls.title: Data in transit protected
controls.requirement: Investor and trading data must be transmitted over current, approved cryptography, and peer certificate validation must not be disabled anywhere in the application.
controls.evidence_hint: outbound calls with certificate verification disabled; permissive trust managers or hostname verifiers; plain http:// internal endpoints carrying investor data

controls.title: Sensitive data protected at rest and minimised
controls.requirement: Investor identifiers, authentication data and financial account data must be encrypted or tokenised where stored, and must not be retained where the function does not require them.
controls.evidence_hint: schema or model fields holding PAN, Aadhaar, bank account or demat identifiers in plaintext; an encryption helper applied at write time or absent

controls.title: Approved cryptography only
controls.requirement: Deprecated ciphers, digests and modes must not be used for any security purpose, and key material must not be embedded in the application.
controls.evidence_hint: MD5, SHA-1, DES, 3DES, RC4 or ECB used for a security purpose; a static IV; key material as a string literal; non-cryptographic randomness for tokens

controls.title: Untrusted input validated before use
controls.requirement: Data received from investors, members and upstream systems must be validated against an expected type and range before reaching a query, command, template or the filesystem.
controls.citation: CSCRF Protect — Platform security and secure application development
controls.evidence_hint: queries, commands, file paths or templates assembled from request values; a schema or serialiser validating the request body, or its absence

controls.title: Deployed configuration hardened
controls.requirement: Debug and diagnostic modes must be off, default credentials removed, management interfaces restricted, and error responses must not disclose stack traces, queries or configuration.
controls.evidence_hint: debug flags enabled; default credentials; management or actuator endpoints exposed unauthenticated; error handlers returning exception text to the client

controls.title: Security-relevant events are logged
controls.requirement: Authentication outcomes, authorisation failures, privileged actions and changes to investor or order records must be logged with actor, action, target and timestamp, so that anomalous activity is detectable.
controls.citation: CSCRF Detect — Continuous monitoring and adverse event analysis
controls.evidence_hint: logging on login success and failure, on permission denial, and on privileged actions; whether the record identifies who did what to which object

controls.title: Logs do not leak sensitive data
controls.requirement: Log records must not contain passwords, OTPs, tokens, full account or PAN values, or whole request bodies and authorization headers.
controls.evidence_hint: logging of request bodies, headers or form data; exception handlers recording locals; a debug log carrying a credential or OTP

controls.title: Third-party components declared and versioned
controls.requirement: Software components and their versions must be identifiable from the codebase, so that a published vulnerability can be traced to the systems that use it.
controls.citation: CSCRF Identify — Asset management (software bill of materials)
controls.evidence_hint: a dependency manifest and a committed lockfile; unpinned or floating version ranges; vendored libraries with no recorded version

controls.title: API resource consumption bounded
controls.requirement: Investor-facing and member-facing interfaces must bound request rate, body size and result-set size, so that a single caller cannot degrade the service for others.
controls.evidence_hint: rate-limit middleware and whether it covers authentication and order endpoints; body size limits on parsers and upload handlers; list endpoints with a capped page size

controls.title: Board-approved cyber security and cyber resilience policy
controls.requirement: A cyber security and cyber resilience policy must be approved by the board or equivalent and reviewed at the prescribed interval.

controls.title: Defined cyber security roles and accountability
controls.requirement: Responsibility for cyber security must be assigned to a designated officer, with roles, authority and escalation defined.
controls.citation: CSCRF Govern — Roles, responsibilities and authorities

controls.title: Cyber Capability Index measured and reported
controls.requirement: Applicable entities must measure their cyber capability against the framework's index at the prescribed frequency and report it as required.

controls.title: Cyber risk management programme
controls.requirement: Cyber risks must be identified, assessed against defined criteria, treated, and tracked in a risk register with accountable owners.

controls.title: Third-party and supply chain risk governance
controls.requirement: Vendors, service providers and outsourced arrangements must be assessed before onboarding and reviewed periodically, with security obligations and audit rights contracted.
controls.citation: CSCRF Govern — Cybersecurity supply chain risk management

controls.title: Inventory of assets and their criticality
controls.requirement: Hardware, software, data and service assets must be inventoried and classified by criticality to the business function.

controls.title: Critical systems identified and scoped
controls.requirement: Critical systems must be explicitly identified and the framework's enhanced requirements applied to them.

controls.title: Data classification scheme applied
controls.requirement: Data must be classified by sensitivity, and handling requirements defined for each classification.

controls.title: Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing programme
controls.requirement: VAPT must be carried out at the prescribed frequency by empanelled auditors, with findings tracked to closure within defined timelines.

controls.title: Periodic cyber audit by an independent auditor
controls.requirement: A cyber audit must be conducted at the prescribed frequency and its report submitted as required, with a declaration from management.

controls.title: Security awareness and training
controls.requirement: Staff, management and relevant third parties must receive periodic cyber security training appropriate to their role.

controls.title: Periodic access review and deprovisioning
controls.requirement: User access must be reviewed at a defined interval and revoked promptly on role change or exit.
controls.citation: CSCRF Protect — Identity management and access control

controls.title: Physical access controls
controls.requirement: Physical access to facilities hosting critical systems must be restricted, logged and reviewed.

controls.title: Network segmentation and perimeter controls
controls.requirement: Networks must be segmented by trust level with controlled, documented connectivity between zones.

controls.title: Patch management within defined timelines
controls.requirement: Security patches must be applied within timelines set by severity, with exceptions recorded and approved.

controls.title: Change management with segregation of duties
controls.requirement: Changes to production must follow an approval workflow with segregation between development, approval and deployment.

controls.title: Data leak prevention controls
controls.requirement: Controls must be in place to detect and prevent unauthorised exfiltration of classified data across endpoints, mail and network egress.

controls.title: Data stored within the permitted jurisdiction
controls.requirement: Regulated data must be stored and processed within the jurisdictions the framework permits, including for cloud and third-party arrangements.

controls.title: Security operations centre coverage
controls.requirement: Continuous monitoring must be provided by an SOC, whether in-house, group or a market-wide facility, with defined coverage hours and escalation.

controls.title: Centralised log collection and correlation
controls.requirement: Logs from critical systems must be collected centrally, retained for the prescribed period, protected from alteration, and correlated for detection.

controls.title: Threat intelligence consumed and acted upon
controls.requirement: Threat intelligence, including advisories shared through the sector's channels, must be received and acted upon.

controls.title: Incident response plan
controls.requirement: A documented incident response plan must define roles, severity classification, containment, eradication and communication.

controls.title: Incident reporting to SEBI and CERT-In
controls.requirement: Cyber incidents must be reported to SEBI and to CERT-In within the prescribed timelines, together with root cause and remediation as required.

controls.title: Forensic readiness and root cause analysis
controls.requirement: Evidence must be preserved and root cause analysis conducted after a significant incident, with findings feeding remediation.

controls.title: Incident response exercises
controls.requirement: Response arrangements must be exercised periodically, including participation in sector-wide drills where required.

controls.title: Recovery objectives defined and tested
controls.requirement: Recovery time and recovery point objectives must be defined for critical systems and validated through periodic testing.
controls.citation: CSCRF Recover — Incident recovery plan execution

controls.title: Backups taken, protected and restoration tested
controls.requirement: Backups of critical data must be taken at a defined frequency, protected against alteration, and restoration must be tested at a defined interval.
controls.citation: CSCRF Recover — Incident recovery plan execution

controls.title: Recovery communication
controls.requirement: Communication to investors, members and regulators during and after an incident must follow a defined plan.

controls.title: Lessons learned feed the control set
controls.requirement: Findings from audits, incidents and exercises must be tracked to closure and used to update controls and the policy.
